Start.title: Connect your thermostat
Start.body: We'll walk you through how to set up your thermostat with this app.

Success.title: Success!
Success.body: The thermostat is connected. You can now control it with this app.

Instructions.title: Instructions
Instructions.item1: 1. On your thermostat, go to Menu / Tools / Wireless
Instructions.item2: 2. Select your WiFi network and tap “connect”
Instructions.item3: 3. Enter the password to connect to your WiFi network and press “ok”

Token.title: Enter Device ID
Token.body: If your screen doesn’t show a Device ID, press “Refresh” or try to reconnect the thermostat to your WiFi.

TokenInvalid.title: Device ID invalid
TokenInvalid.message: Make sure the token entered matches the token displayed on your thermostat

AccountSharing.subtitle: Quickly sign in to your %{appName} account on another device.
AccountSharing.description: Start by downloading the %{appName} app on another phone or tablet. Then, scan this QR code using that device's camera to automatically sign in to your %{appName} account.
